section.title: Gantry operator panel with Touch Panel
section.hierarchy_path: /System description/Scan unit (gantry)/Gantry operator panels/Gantry operator panel with Touch Panel

semantic_nodes.canonical_text: Gantry operator panel with Touch Panel
The gantry operator panel allows you to control the gantry functions, the movement of the patient table, and trigger scanning.
The gantry operator panel is located to the left and right hand side of the front and rear of the gantry. The gantry operator panels at the rear are optional.
Force / Force Velo | Instructions for Use Print No. C2-058-C.621.01.01.02
SOMATOM | syngo CT VB30 99
3 System description

The top keys of the Touch Panel are mirrored on each side of the gantry. On the left-hand side of the gantry the Stop key is located on the right, as shown below, and on the right-hand side of the gantry the Stop key is located on the left.
Stop key
Press the STOP key to interrupt unit movements. Radiation is stopped immediately.
Touch Panel
Displays scan parameters and can be used to control defined CT scanner functions. ( Page 102 Touch Panel)
Vertical patient table movement Press these keys to elevate or lower the patient table. ( Page 179 Moving the table top vertically)
Horizontal patient table movement
Press these keys to move the patient table in or out of the gantry.
( Page 180 Moving the table top horizontally)
Move key
Press the Move key to move the patient table to a predefined horizontal and vertical position. ( Page 185 Unloading the patient) ( Page 289 Moving the patient into the scan plane)
Start key
Press the Start key to trigger scanning.
Suspend key
Press the Suspend key to interrupt the current scan.
Laser lightmarker key Use this key to switch the laser lightmarker on and off. It turns off automatically after 60 seconds. ( Page 290 Using the internal laser lightmarker)
Force / Force Velo | Instructions for Use Print No. C2-058-C.621.01.01.02
SOMATOM | syngo CT VB30 100
3 System description
WARNING
Incorrect patient positioning, unintended patient movement, and unobserved movement of the patient table or gantry!
Injury to the patient, for example, contusions of the patient's extremities and unusable radiation.
◆ Always fix the patient with accessories, as described in the instructions for use, to avoid unintentional patient movement. For example, use restraint straps and arm supports.

◆ Monitor the patient continuously as long as the table top and gantry are moving. Take special care if the tilt of the gantry is anything other than zero degrees or the table height is anything other than the isocenter.

◆ Make sure that nothing can get caught while the table or gantry are moving. For example, parts of the body or clothing, any needles, infusion tubes, respiration tubes, catheters, ECG cables, or sheets and blankets.
◆ Follow the markings and labels on the equipment.
◆ Press a STOP key if an injury to the patient can occur.
WARNING
Malfunction of the system or the equipment!
Injury to the patient or personnel, unintended radiation exposure or damage to the equipment.
◆ Press a STOP key at any unintentional system movement and in any hazardous situation.
◆ Press an EMERGENCY OFF key if the system does not respond to the STOP keys in any hazardous situation.
◆ Shut down the system immediately if system malfunctions are detected and notify the Customer Service at Siemens Healthineers.

section.title: Laser lightmarkers
section.hierarchy_path: /System description/Scan unit (gantry)/Gantry operator panels/Gantry operator panel with Touch Panel/Laser lightmarkers

semantic_nodes.canonical_text: Laser lightmarkers
This key turns on and off the laser lightmarkers.
Force / Force Velo | Instructions for Use Print No. C2-058-C.621.01.01.02
SOMATOM | syngo CT VB30
3 System description
The laser lightmarkers are laser beams that emanate from three marked points in the gantry opening. The laser beams create line marks. The beams can cross and create intersections.
The laser lightmarkers indicate the position of the scan center and the slice plane in the middle of the detector rows.
For interventional examinations, the laser lightmarkers are switched off automatically after approximately one minute.

You can optionally use the Auto Laser function to turn on or off the laser lightmarkers upon arriving at the start position. To activate the Auto Laser, in the settings popover on the Touch Panel go to General settings. ( Page 105 General settings)

The Touch Panel is part of the gantry operator panel. It displays scan parameters and can be used to control defined CT scanner functions.

Patient data display ( Page 103 Patient data display)
The Touch Panel screen saver cannot be stopped by touching the panel.
Stop the screen saver at your syngo Acquisition Workplace.

semantic_nodes.canonical_text: Line On/Off reset button

With the Line On/Off reset button, you can disconnect the entire system from the mains power supply immediately. After releasing the Line On/Off reset button, the system always returns to its previous state.

The system does not automatically check whether it is safe to shut down. If you need to disconnect the entire system, you must first close all open applications and, if possible, shut down the operating system at the console. Then press and hold the Line On/Off reset button on the gantry for approximately 10 seconds. After approximately 30 seconds, the system starts up automatically.

Caution, leg injuries

Increased risk that body parts can get pinched between table and floor. Take care when lowering the patient table to avoid injury to body parts. To avoid damaging the patient table, make sure no accessories (for example, a trolley or cart) are placed underneath the patient table while lowering it.

section.title: RTP adaptor connections
section.hierarchy_path: /System description/Patient Table/Multi‑purpose table/Table tops for the multi-purpose table/Radiation Therapy Planning (RTP) table top/RTP adaptor connections

semantic_nodes.canonical_text: RTP adaptor connections
For a standardized patient setup, the table top provides different mounting possibilities (indexing systems). ( Page 48 During system movements)
Slots along both sides of the RTP table top (for restraint straps)
Indentation (Interloc Indexing)
Bore hole
Plug connection for positioning aids
The indentations are used to mount adaptors.

The bore holes can be furnished with lens head screws. The screws are used to mount different accessories (for example, adaptors, rulers). The indexing systems are compatible with most of the accessories used in radiation therapy.
Screw sockets located on the foot end for external devices
For instructions using accessories see the instruction for use of the manufacturer.
